selection_principles: Pair every answer with the exact evidence span and document identity.
Include answerable, unanswerable, conflicting, stale, and partially supported cases.
Do not treat fluent unsupported answers as positive examples.

mixing_guidance: Train answerability and abstention together so refusal does not become the cheapest policy.
Keep retrieval quality and generation quality separately measurable.
Use document-level, not row-level, separation between train and evaluation.
gaps: Numeric promotion floor after base baseline
